description: Deterministic sub-100ms lookup of a signed patch or verified workaround for an agent execution error. Accepts raw error traceback / exception strings (raw_error), package/tool names (target), or pre-computed SHA-256 fingerprints (fingerprint). Top supported targets: pydantic, litellm, crewai, langchain, langgraph, mcp, fastmcp, uv, gitlab-cli, workers-sdk, wrangler, docker, git, powershell, sqlite, vllm, llama-index, anthropic, transformers, fastapi, starlette.

environment.description: Optional environment attributes (os, runtime, package, version).

failure.description: Optional structured failure details (error_code, exit_code, raw_signature).

fingerprint.description: Optional 64-char hex SHA-256 fingerprint for direct cache lookup.

raw_error.description: Raw stderr, exception traceback, or error message (e.g. 'ZoneInfo validation error', 'ImportError: cannot import name ...').

target.description: Target package or tool name (e.g. pydantic, litellm, crewai, langchain, mcp, uv, httpx, wrangler).

name: fmagenticl_resolve
